agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime remain zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational progress only under v2.1 and must not become verified Experience, P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality or Governance evidence.

v2.1 strict-bool checks for secretary_signal_fresh, authority_conflict and direct event_independently_verified are valid type hardening, but do not establish provenance, freshness or verifier authority.
Fresh v2.1 correctly handles terminal N/R before G-gear parsing and bounds non-Mapping ledger elements.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only; keeping it observational is acceptable until independently derived and adversarially validated.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly states speedup is NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.
formal_mutation_allowed remains false and P_base remains read-only.

disagreements.finding: New material finding: v2.1 hardens only its own three boolean inputs. Inherited v1/v2 flags such as standby, rollback_required, hard_safety_conflict, contradiction, recovery_active and route_drift still rely on Python truthiness. A caller value like the non-empty string "false" is therefore truthy and can falsely trigger N standby, R rollback, G1 recovery/safety brake or pressure downshift/checkpoint. Existing v2 tests cover literal booleans only.
disagreements.required_change: Create one canonical strict-bool intake shared by v1/v2/v2.1 for every control boolean before any routing logic. Reject strings, integers, lists, mappings and arbitrary objects; live/adoptable paths must not rely on Python truthiness for control state.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events parses independently_verified before rejecting missing event_id; malformed verification data on an identity-less record can abort later valid evidence in the batch.
disagreements.required_change: Validate canonical record shape and non-empty event identity before verifier parsing; non-atomic malformed records must be bounded rejects with zero credit and no identity reservation.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict remain caller declarations. Strict bool proves type only, not source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, policy or runtime/install binding.
disagreements.required_change: Consume typed SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope bound to source, scope, freshness, policy and runtime/install identity.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only neutralizes secretary_level; it does not load or enforce the actual fresh authority decision.
disagreements.required_change: Project the exact trusted authority snapshot; stale, revoked or cross-scope authority evidence must fail closed.

disagreements.finding: Stale secretary handling neutralizes secretary_level but numeric pressure inputs remain unbound to per-field provenance/freshness, so stale secretary-derived telemetry can still force checkpoint/downshift.
disagreements.required_change: Bind provenance/freshness per pressure component; stale secretary-derived components are ignored while independently trusted fresh runtime telemetry may still contribute.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum support, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive it from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can lower gear_shift_rate while delaying necessary safe upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure throughput or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still requires only event kind plus a boolean in current executable paths; exact evidence hash, trusted verifier identity and receipt are not mandatory.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only within one aggregate invocation; same evidence under new IDs, cross-run/restart/rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Both credit classes must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Public v2 still exposes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND through experience_candidate_delta although v2.1 classifies them operational-only.
disagreements.required_change: Unify v2/v2.1 authoritative classification; operational events must never appear in an authoritative Experience-labelled field.

disagreements.finding: Gearbox v2 can set real_experience_claim_allowed from verified-kind credit without requiring verification_stage=C_VERIFIED or an exact trusted acceptance receipt.
disagreements.required_change: Authoritative real/verified Experience eligibility must require exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt and compatible canonical verification stage.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline protocol establishes speedup; commit count, wake count or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen numerator/denominator provenance, exposure/censoring/order, full assigned-workload coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Inherited bool truthiness can create false standby/rollback/recovery/route-drift labels and contaminate safety and performance measurements even when v2.1-local booleans are strict.
Malformed missing-ID mappings can censor later records because verifier parsing occurs before identity rejection, creating order-dependent missingness.
Caller-declared secretary freshness or authority conflict invalidates causal routing comparisons.
Stale secretary-derived numeric pressure fields can leak through even when secretary_level is suppressed.
Small-n shift-rate estimates have high variance and can false-trigger or chatter around a single threshold.
Anti-thrash can improve gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if policy-created progress is later fed back into upshift decisions.
Transient event identity and direct decision-path credit can inflate longitudinal verified/operational totals.
Operational-vs-Experience semantics differ between public v2 and v2.1 interfaces, making mixed-consumer metrics incomparable.
real_experience_claim_allowed can disagree with canonical verification stage and contaminate longitudinal labels.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
durable_progress_per_wake is numerator/denominator-sensitive; verified_closure_per_hour is exposure/censoring-sensitive; fixed order and completed-only analysis create carryover/survivorship bias.
proposed_tests: GB21-INHERITED-BOOL-BOUNDARY-085: for standby, rollback_required, hard_safety_conflict, contradiction, recovery_active and route_drift, values "false", "true", "0", "1", 0, 1, [], {} and arbitrary objects must fail closed; only literal bool is accepted.
GB21-INHERITED-BOOL-SEMANTICS-086: literal False preserves baseline routing and literal True triggers the intended control path; false-like strings must never trigger N/R/G1/checkpoint.
GB21-MISSING-ID-VERIFY-PARSE-083 + MISSING-ID-NO-POISON-084: identity-less malformed records are bounded rejects and cannot abort or poison later valid evidence.
GB21-STALE-PRESSURE-PROVENANCE-059 + MIXED-SOURCE-060: stale secretary-derived pressure fields are ignored while independently trusted fresh telemetry remains effective.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery projects G1 even when fallback caller kwargs are permissive.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift history, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded release are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is tied to one immutable accepted receipt.
GB21-V2-V21-CLASSIFIER-CONSISTENCY-078 + REAL-EXPERIENCE-STAGE-079/080: public authoritative interfaces share semantics and trusted stage/receipt binding.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen metric provenance, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.
release_condition: No formal adoption or speedup claim from this research review alone.
All inherited control booleans across v1/v2/v2.1 use one strict typed boundary; Python truthiness is forbidden for routing/safety state.
Missing-ID or malformed records cannot abort later independent valid evidence and cannot reserve event identity.
Secretary freshness/provenance must be evidence-bound per signal/component; fresh authority must be projected from an exact trusted decision, not a caller boolean.
Anti-thrash inputs must be canonically derived with adequate sample support, uncertainty and hysteretic release; cycle/closure/recovery performance must be non-inferior.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and tested against feedback/self-reinforcement.

Verified Experience and operational progress must come from durable accepted evidence/receipts with rollback-resistant identity/lineage dedupe; decision calls without accepted receipts produce zero credit.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only across every authoritative public interface; runtime maintenance remains zero Experience.
Real Experience eligibility requires exact evidence identity plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt and compatible canonical verification stage.
Credit weights remain heuristic-only and cannot drive capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality or promotion.

Speedup requires sealed matched paired/crossover baseline using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with fixed metric provenance/exposure/order/coverage, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 verified foundation remain preserved; P_base stays read-only; real_5min_runtime_live remains false until separate real authorized evidence exists.
